drugs.name: Digoxin

drugs.name: Phenytoin Sodium

drugs.name: Theophylline

therapeuticRange.description: Therapeutic target: 10–20 mcg/mL (5–15 mcg/mL in some modern protocols); levels > 20 mcg/mL cause arrhythmias, seizures, and hypokalemia.

crclThresholds.adjustment: Primarily hepatic metabolism (~90%); no formal renal dose reduction, but monitor closely in severe renal failure.

hepaticRules.childPughAdjustment: Extensive CYP1A2 and CYP2E1 metabolism. Cirrhosis or severe acute hepatitis can double or triple half-life; reduce maintenance dose by 50%.

majorInteractions.mechanism: CYP1A2 inhibition reduces theophylline clearance by 30-50%, risking severe neurotoxicity
